threats.title: Suspicious Login from Foreign IP & Geolocation Anomaly
threats.description: Concurrent authentication session detected for admin account "sec-ops@darkwatch.corp" originating from known Tor exit node while active session exists in San Jose, CA.
threats.payloadSummary: SSH-2.0-OpenSSH_8.9p1 / Kerberos token spoofing attempt detected with abnormal entropy.
threats.recommendedAction: Terminate remote session, revoke OAuth refresh tokens, and enforce immediate hardware MFA challenge.

threats.title: Data Exfiltration via DNS Tunneling & Encrypted Payload
threats.description: High-frequency base64 encoded TXT records sent to newly registered domain "ns1.telemetry-sync-cdn.top" bypassing egress proxy filters.
threats.payloadSummary: 4,280 queries in 90 seconds. Decoded fragments contain customer PII hashes and database schema identifiers.
threats.recommendedAction: Apply DNS Sinkhole policy at edge resolvers, sever DB network socket, and dump forensic memory capture.

threats.title: Unusual Outbound Traffic Spike & Port Scan Burst
threats.description: Rapid TCP SYN sweep across internal 10.240.0.0/16 subnets originating from compromised ingress pod running nginx 1.18.
threats.recommendedAction: Isolate compromised Kubernetes pod namespace, update Calico NetworkPolicy, and block attacker CIDR.

threats.title: Malware Signature Match (Cobalt Strike Beacon in Memory)
threats.description: YARA rule YARA_COBALT_STRIKE_PIPE_MATCH triggered on process svchost.exe injecting into memory space of runner-worker.exe.
threats.payloadSummary: Reflective DLL injection detected via VirtualAllocEx with PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE permissions.
threats.recommendedAction: Quarantine build host, kill offending PID tree, and roll back runner VM snapshot.

threats.title: Security Policy Violation & Unauthorized S3 Bucket ACL Change
threats.description: S3 PutBucketAcl API invoked with "public-read" grants on internal telemetry backup bucket without change ticket approval.
threats.payloadSummary: AWS CloudTrail event PutBucketAcl from IAM User svc-analytics-etl.
threats.recommendedAction: Restore bucket ACL to private via AWS SCP guardrail and revoke etl access key.

threats.title: Spear-Phishing Payload Attachment Detonation in Sandbox
threats.description: Macro-enabled invoice document "Q4_Vendor_Statement.xlsm" attempted outbound connection to drop-site.
threats.payloadSummary: Sandbox intercepted malicious VBA auto-exec macro downloading secondary payload.
threats.recommendedAction: Purge weaponized email from all 48 recipient mailboxes and blacklist sender domain.

vulnerabilities.title: XZ Utils Backdoor Liblzma Malicious Code Execution
vulnerabilities.description: Malicious code inserted into upstream release tarballs interferes with authentication in sshd under certain systemd configurations, allowing unauthorized SSH RCE.
mitigationSteps: Downgrade liblzma to 5.4.5 or install vendor verified safe build
Restart sshd and audit all active SSH sessions
Deploy DarkWatch automated canary patch to edge nodes

vulnerabilities.title: regreSSHion: OpenSSH Server Remote Code Execution
vulnerabilities.description: Signal handler race condition in OpenSSH server (sshd) on glibc-based Linux systems allows unauthenticated remote code execution with root privileges.
mitigationSteps: Set LoginGraceTime to 0 in sshd_config as immediate interim mitigation
Deploy openssh 9.8p1 patch across Linux fleet
Restrict SSH ingress to VPN tunnel CIDRs only

vulnerabilities.title: Microsoft Outlook Remote Code Execution (MonikerLink)
vulnerabilities.description: Specially crafted file:// URL bypasses Protected View, triggering NTLM credential relay and arbitrary code execution upon email preview.
mitigationSteps: Push Microsoft Office 365 Monthly Enterprise Channel hotfix update
Block outbound SMB port 445 at corporate perimeter firewall
Enable Outlook Protected View mandatory override policy via Intune

vulnerabilities.title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Distributed Denial of Service
vulnerabilities.description: RST_STREAM frame stream reset abuse overwhelms server CPU with concurrent bidirectional stream handling, driving 100% thread pool exhaustion.
mitigationSteps: Update NGINX to 1.25.3 or apply keepalive_requests throttling
Enable Cloudflare / AWS Shield Layer 7 HTTP/2 Rapid Reset managed mitigation rule

vulnerabilities.title: runc Container Breakout via Leaked File Descriptor
vulnerabilities.description: Internal file descriptors leaked to child process in runc allow container processes to access host filesystem via /proc/self/fd/7.
mitigationSteps: Upgrade runc to >= 1.1.12 on Kubernetes node pools
Enforce read-only root filesystems and AppArmor default profiles
